# Rosebank Art Centre

> A community art facility in Te Awamutu, New Zealand, run as a charitable trust by its members. It holds exhibitions, runs workshops and classes, and gives local artists a place to work and show their art.

Address: 337 Churchill Street, Te Awamutu 3800, New Zealand
Email: rosebankartcentre@gmail.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rosebankartcentre

## Pages

- [Events](https://rosebankartcentre.org/events): exhibitions, workshops and classes, upcoming and past
- [Gallery](https://rosebankartcentre.org/gallery): work by member artists
- [About](https://rosebankartcentre.org/about): who runs the centre and how to join
- [Contact](https://rosebankartcentre.org/contact): how to find and reach the centre
